page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with two two-column paradigm tables below it (Singularis Numerus, then Pluralis Numerus). Running head centred at top, page number at top right, gathering signature at bottom centre.

main_text.p: præponitur. Dicimus ʒween / in masculino genere, ʒwo in fœminino, ʒwey[?] in neutro.
main_text.head: Quot sunt Casus?
main_text.p: Sex: Nominativus, Genitivus, Dativus, Accusati-vus, Vocativus & Ablativus.
main_text.head: Quot sunt Declinationes apud Germanos?
Quid est prima declinatio?
main_text.p: Prima Declinatio est quæ complectitur nomina masculini vel neutrius generis. Quædam bifariam Nominativo casu efferuntur: ut, der frieD & friede[?]/ pax, das aug & auge/ oculus, das gesinD & gesinde/ familia, der garten & garte / hortus, der nammen & namme/nomen, der jamen & same[?]/semen, der huften & huste/tussis, der wagen & wage/currus, der kasten & kaste[?] / arca. Juxta priorem terminationem casus formantur: ut, des nammens/des samens[?].
main_text.head: Singularis Numerus.
main_text.l: N. Der meister/ magister, | Das land/ regio.
main_text.head: Pluralis Numerus.
main_text.l: V. O ihr meister/ | O ihr länder.
A. Von den meistern. | Von den ländern.

page.notes: Black letter (Fraktur) German words are marked with bl; the scan is faint in places. Doubtful readings: "ʒwey" (neuter numeral), "friede", "same" in "der jamen & same" (printed form looks like "jamen"), "kaste" (possibly "tafte"), "des samens", the ablative "Vom" (the initial may be a Fraktur D), and "Vom" in the second Singularis row. The Pluralis forms "länder" and "ländern" may be printed with a different vowel mark. Question headings are set in italic and treated as level 3. Long s is plain s throughout. Running head and page number are printed at top; signature "a 5" is at the foot.
